story.heading: From brief to live page in three moves

steps.title: Describe the product in one paragraph
steps.body: No wireframes, no moodboards. Write what you are building and who it is for — Beacon extracts tone, color direction, and type direction as editable decisions.

steps.title: Review a composed draft, not a blank canvas
steps.body: You get a full funnel — hero, proof, demo, pricing — already wired to your tokens. Every section is a file you can reorder, replace, or delete.

steps.title: Publish and keep iterating in code
steps.body: The output is plain React and CSS variables. Your team edits it like any other code — no lock-in surface between the draft and production.

demo.heading: Watch a page assemble itself
demo.body: The same loop runs for every brief: generate, verify against the token contract, deploy a preview.

items.question: Do I own the output?
items.answer: Yes. The result is plain React components and CSS variables in your repository — no runtime dependency on Beacon.

items.question: Can I change the section order?
items.answer: Every section is an independent file. Reorder, remove, or duplicate them like any other component — the composition is yours.

items.question: What happens to my brand tokens?
items.answer: Tokens live in one CSS definition layer that you edit. Every section reads from it, so a palette change re-themes the whole page.

items.question: Does it work without JavaScript animation libraries?
items.answer: Core motion uses CSS scroll timelines with reduced-motion fallbacks. Nothing breaks when animation is unavailable — content always renders.
